title: Use one recipient cap for text sends and say it in the refusal
body: The p2p phone-list build kept its own copy of the 200,000 recipient cap while the purchase estimate and the Serve flows read MAX_AUDIENCE_RECIPIENTS. They agree today, but a change to one would let the estimate approve a list the build then refuses, so the build now reads the shared constant. The Serve refusals also read badly: the pay step said "over the 200000 constituent limit" and the send said "over the recipient limit" with no number. Both now share one message that names 200,000 and tells the official what to do.
author: delegate-eval
